name: What causes window frames to rot?

mainEntity.name: What causes window frames to rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window frames typically rot due to prolonged exposure to moisture. This can happen from poor drainage around the window, failed caulking, cracked paint allowing water penetration, or condensation buildup if ventilation is insufficient. Wood frames are most susceptible, but even vinyl or aluminum can have issues if water gets trapped in their components, leading to damage to adjacent building materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window frames rot primarily from prolonged moisture exposure due to issues like poor drainage, failed caulking, or condensation buildup.
